hnc-soru-yasin.soru: In which surah of the Qur'an is Habib-i Neccar, who gives the mosque its name, mentioned?
ipuclari: The surah's name comes from two letters: Yâ and Sîn.
hnc-soru-yasin.dogru_metin: Habib-i Neccar is a martyr praised in the Surah Yâsin; according to the book, his grave is inside the mosque.
hnc-soru-yasin.yanlis_metin: Try again. You can ask for a hint below.

hnc-hikaye.ad: You listened to Habib-i Neccar Mosque
hnc-hikaye.metin: You listened to or read the story of Habib-i Neccar Mosque to the end.

hnc-yasin.metin: You got to know Habib-i Neccar, who gives the mosque its name.
